comments.text:
At 17:21 It might be different in the US, but in the UK we don't check for a pulse before CPR when providing first aid. We follow DRS ABC: 
Danger - Check for danger before approaching
Response - Check for Response
Shout - Call 999, tell a specific person around you to call 999 and get another to get a defib if available.
Airways - Open the airways by tilting the head back
Breathing - Listen over their mouth and nose, check to see if their chest is rising, or if you can feel their breath on your cheek (done for 10 seconds)
Circulation - Begin chest compressions/CPR
There's no check for a pulse done.

comments.text: Funny story about intercostal muscles: I'm hypermobile, and around 19 the physio at the chiropractors office changed.
